title: Solar System Explorer — explainer overview
notes: Warm gift framing + navigation overview. Synced 1:1 with slides in tools/make_demo_videos.sh.

lines.text: This is Solar System Explorer — another world on Star Learner, made for a six-year-old who wants to fly among the planets.
It opens with a quiet tour of the solar system. Watch the planets circle the Sun, then pick up the controls yourself.
Swipe across the planets. Tap one to plot a course. The Sun is fair game too — we fly close, but we never land on a star.
A top-down map draws the path. Worlds are moving, so the ship aims ahead of where the destination will be.
Then you fly it — cockpit view, a little course console over the wheel, and planets that grow as you arrive.
Park in orbit, learn more with a short video, or chart a new course. Exploration is the loop. Wonder is the reward.
